description: Admin UI: layout, dashboard, businesses table, users table, categories page. Depends on FEAT-001 (imports from src/app/actions/admin.ts and uses AdminStats/BusinessWithOwner types). All files are new creations under src/app/admin/.
steps:
1. Create src/app/admin/layout.tsx (server component). Pattern mirrors src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx. Key differences: bg-gray-900 sidebar, white text, purple accent on hover. Steps:
   - `export const instant = false`
   - await createClient(), get user, if no user redirect('/auth/login')
   - fetch profile, if role !== 'admin' redirect('/')
   - show full_name and email in sidebar header
   - Nav links: { href: '/admin', label: 'Dashboard', icon: LayoutDashboard }, { href: '/admin/negocios', label: 'Negocios', icon: Store }, { href: '/admin/usuarios', label: 'Usuarios', icon: Users }, { href: '/admin/categorias', label: 'Categorías', icon: Tag }
   - Sign out button at bottom using `<form action={signOut}><Button ...>` same as dashboard layout
   - Main content area: bg-gray-100 flex-1 p-6

2. Create src/app/admin/page.tsx (server component, dashboard). Steps:
   - `export const instant = false`
   - Call getAdminStats() from '@/app/actions/admin'
   - Render a page title 'Panel de Administración'
   - Metric cards row (use Card from shadcn/ui): Total Negocios, Negocios Activos, Negocios Verificados, Total Usuarios, Pendientes de Verificación — each as a Card with icon + number
   - Below cards: 'Negocios por Categoría' section as a simple list (category name + count badge)
   - If getAdminStats() returns { error }, show error message

3. Create src/components/admin/ToggleBusinessButton.tsx ('use client'). Props: { businessId: string; field: 'active' | 'verified'; currentValue: boolean }. On click calls toggleBusinessActive(businessId) or toggleBusinessVerified(businessId) from '@/app/actions/admin'. Use useState for optimistic UI and show a loading spinner during the action. Button text: active field → currentValue ? 'Desactivar' : 'Activar'; verified field → currentValue ? 'No Verificado' : 'Verificar'.

4. Create src/app/admin/negocios/page.tsx (server component). Steps:
   - `export const instant = false`
   - Call getAllBusinesses() from '@/app/actions/admin'
   - Render a full-width table with columns: Nombre, Categoría, Propietario (show profiles.full_name if available, else first 8 chars of owner_id + '...'), Estado (Badge: is_active → green 'Activo' / red 'Inactivo'), Verificación (Badge: is_verified → blue 'Verificado' / yellow 'Pendiente'), Fecha registro (formatted dd/MM/yyyy using date-fns format()), Acciones
   - Acciones column: two ToggleBusinessButton components (one for active, one for verified)
   - Wrap table in a Card, add page title 'Negocios' and total count

5. Create src/components/admin/ChangeRoleButton.tsx ('use client'). Props: { userId: string; currentRole: 'user' | 'owner' }. On click calls changeUserRole(userId, currentRole === 'user' ? 'owner' : 'user') from '@/app/actions/admin'. Show loading state. Button text: currentRole === 'user' ? 'Hacer Propietario' : 'Quitar Propietario'.

6. Create src/app/admin/usuarios/page.tsx (server component). Steps:
   - `export const instant = false`
   - Call getAllUsers() from '@/app/actions/admin'
   - Render table with columns: Nombre (full_name or 'Sin nombre'), ID/Email (truncate id to 8 chars + '...'), Rol (Badge: admin → red destructive, owner → purple secondary, user → gray outline), Registro (formatted date), Negocios (count from businesses aggregate if owner), Acciones (ChangeRoleButton — only show for non-admin users)
   - Wrap in Card, add page title 'Usuarios'

7. Create src/app/admin/categorias/page.tsx (server component). Steps:
   - `export const instant = false`
   - Call getCategories() from '@/app/actions/business' (already exists and returns all categories)
   - For each category, also fetch business count: use a single supabase query `select('id, name, slug, icon, color, businesses(count)')` directly in this page (no new server action needed, or create a helper in admin.ts named getCategoriesWithCount)
   - Actually: add a getCategoriesWithCount() function to src/app/actions/admin.ts that runs `supabase.from('categories').select('*, businesses(count)').order('name')` — add this as a 7th function in FEAT-001's admin.ts (retroactively include it in the admin.ts file created in FEAT-001 step 2, or add it here)
   - Render a grid/list of category cards: color circle (w-4 h-4 rounded-full with inline style background color), icon name text, category name, slug, business count badge
   - Page is read-only, no action buttons
   - Page title: 'Categorías'
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /admin as an admin user shows the dashboard with metric cards.
Navigating to /admin/negocios shows all businesses including inactive ones in a table.
Clicking toggle buttons in the negocios table updates the business status and revalidates the page.
Navigating to /admin/usuarios shows all profiles with role badges.
Navigating to /admin/categorias shows all categories with business counts.
`npm run build` passes with 0 TypeScript errors and 0 ESLint errors.
All UI text is in Spanish.
verification: Run `npm run build` in c:\Users\Alanis\Documents\apps ideas\encuentrameTB and confirm it exits with code 0.
Confirm the build output lists these routes: /admin, /admin/negocios, /admin/usuarios, /admin/categorias.
findings: 1) Badge component in this project uses @base-ui/react internals — className overrides work fine for custom colors (bg-green-100 text-green-800 pattern confirmed). 2) date-fns v4 is installed; format() from 'date-fns' works as expected. 3) categories field on BusinessWithOwner is typed as Category | undefined in the Business type, cast to { name?: string } in the table to avoid TS errors. 4) getAllUsers businesses aggregate returns {count: number}[] but TS sees it as an array of objects — cast via `as unknown as { count: number }[]` consistent with FEAT-001 pattern. 5) Build passes exit code 0; all four /admin routes appear in route manifest. 6) No TypeScript or ESLint errors.
